name: Geeked-Out Basketball
summary: Think you have the coaching chops to build a dynasty? Prove it. Geeked-Out Basketball is a deep high school basketball management sim: recruit and develop your players, scout opponents, craft your game plans, and call every possession live. Depth you can actually see and feel.
